description:
## Problem
Fetcher contains several magic numbers and hardcoded values:
- `max_gray_attempts = 3` in fetch_loop (should be a Config field or constant)
- `256` in google_larger_url and gray_fallback_url (Google favicon size parameter)
- Google favicon URL template `"https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=#{encoded}&sz=256"` duplicated in gray_fallback_url
- DDG URL pattern `/ip3/(.+?)\.ico` hardcoded in extract_domain_from_ddg_url

## Proposal
1. Extract `GOOGLE_FAVICON_URL_TEMPLATE` and `GOOGLE_FAVICON_SIZE = 256` as constants
2. Extract `DDG_IP3_PATH_PATTERN` as a constant regex
3. Move `max_gray_attempts` to Config or make it a class constant
4. Consider extracting all external service URL patterns into a constants section at the top of the class (or the new GrayPlaceholderHandler if vugcr-ber is done first)

## Benefits
- Easier to update service URLs/parameters in one place
- Self-documenting: named constants explain what magic numbers mean
- Reduces risk of inconsistency from duplicated values
title: Replace magic numbers with named constants in Fetcher
